correctness.rationale: The theorem has precise quantifiers for odd cohort sizes 2r+1 with r>=1, all integer allocations and 0<ell<h<1. Replacing one Bernoulli trial changes a strict-majority event by (h-ell) times the pivotal r-success mass. Complementing all 2r Bernoulli outcomes and swapping the two probabilities provides a word-by-word likelihood ratio independent of the word, [h(1-h)/(ell(1-ell))]^(k-r). This exact central-mass identity yields the adjacent derivative sign h+ell-1 and strictness, while reflection establishes all global optima and the complement at equality yields probability 1/2. Exact rational Poisson-binomial convolution independently checks 11303 assertions for sizes 3 to 21 and explicit rational witnesses; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: A literature-led, statement-level review found no inspected source proving the universal odd-cohort composition trichotomy under precisely two swapped conditional Bernoulli environments. Unlike generic diversification/geometric-mean results and heterogeneous-majority grouping theorems, this claim is about a single-season strict survival quorum at every odd sample size. The per-word central-mass odds identity supplies an explicit new-to-this-review implication. Search nonmatches do not prove historical novelty; known mathematical identities and inaccessible literature remain risks.
residual_risks: A classical unpublished or unindexed identity in Poisson-binomial sums, optimal heterogeneous juries, or reverse-symmetry inequalities may imply the exact allocation classification.

value.rationale: A natural one-season establishment event requires a strict majority of an odd cohort. The result gives a complete, exactly sharp and size-independent allocation decision among all integer phenotype compositions, not just an infinitesimal or local perturbation. The outcome is surprising because the phenotypes have identical marginal individual survival probability under the shared uncertain environment, yet their best mix switches between extreme concentration and near-even diversification. The exact neutral case and nonzero quantified adjacent gaps isolate the structural reason and provide a reproducible benchmark; no extrapolation to real conservation planning is asserted.
